content.xhtml:p: STOP_BTN negated to become TRUE when pressed, stopping/breaking the RUN_STATE logic.
START_BTN is pressed, closing the connection to STATUS_RUN RUN_STATE.
RUN_STATE is parallel to START_BTN, this is an OR gate and works as a latch. START_BTN press powers the RUN_STATE, while RUN_STATE is TRUE, the RUN_STATE remains TRUE.

SR0 LATCH sets/holds E_STATE if the RUN_STATE and E_STOP are TRUE. SR0 is RESET, changing E_STATE to FALSE if E_STATE AND E_STOP are TRUE.
Therefore, to disable the E_STATE, both the E_STOP(That enables the E_STATE) AND E_STOP must be TRUE to RESET the SR0.
